wilsonAmboseliWilson.note: Depending on loads may occasionally fly Amboseli direct to Masai Mara. Connects to Mara/Nanyuki/Loisaba/Lewa/Samburu.

wilsonAmboseliTsavoWilson.airstripsServed: Finch Hattons, Mwatate, Taita Hills, Voi, Oldonyo Wuas, Kilaguni (plus Ziwani and Satao per the 2025 schedule doc)

amboseliTsavoMara.note: Occasionally routes via Wilson, arriving Masai Mara ~10:30am. Timings are estimates.

wilsonNanyuki.airstripsServed: Mt. Kenya Game Ranch, Nanyuki Civil, Nanyuki Kamok

nanyukiToMasaiMara.note: May occasionally route via Wilson, connecting to Mara service at 14:30, arriving 15:15. CROSS-CHECK: AirKenya's competing Nanyuki-Masai Mara fare is $446 rack (see flights-air-kenya-routes-2026.json) and Safarilink's is $441 published/$374.80 nett+$15 tax (see flights-amboseli-mara-nanyuki-2026.json) - ALS is the cheapest of the three carriers on this specific route as extracted, not a data error, just genuine inter-carrier price variation.

nanyukiKamokNamunyakMasaiMaraSetDepartur.note: Set-departure service, non-commissionable, fares are PER SEAT with NO child fare (differs from the general 75%-of-adult child policy elsewhere in this contract). Operates with a minimum of six (6) passengers.

wilsonMaraWilsonTwiceDaily.minPax: 2 per airstrip (all airstrips including Cottars & Siana)
wilsonMaraWilsonTwiceDaily.note: Wilson arrivals from this service can connect same-day to Vipingo, Ukunda, Amboseli/Tsavo in the afternoon.

wilsonUkundaVipingoWilsonSeasonal.seasonalWindow: Seasonal flight - operates Easter holidays, Public holidays, High Season (1 Jul-30 Sep) and Festive/Christmas Season (8 Dec-8 Jan). Off-season: contact res@flyals.com for promotional/group fares.
wilsonUkundaVipingoWilsonSeasonal.note: NET rate is inclusive of tax and applies equally to adult and child (no child discount on this specific route).
wilsonUkundaVipingoWilsonSeasonal.baggageAllowanceNote: 20kg per person on this route (vs 15kg on the safari/bush routes) per the 2025 schedule doc.

maraMigoriHighSeasonOnly.note: Connects into Serengeti with Auric Air Tanzania.

maraSerengetiViaMigoriTarimeHighSeasonOn.note: Taxes include ground transfer between Migori (KE) and Tarime (TZ). On inducement, 2 seats to book, minimum 4 seats to operate.
maraSerengetiViaMigoriTarimeHighSeasonOn.note2: Reverse direction (Serengeti via Tarime via Migori to Mara) uses identical fares/rack/net/tax figures, just reversed schedule times - not duplicated here, same numbers apply both ways per source table.

multiSectorDiscount2026.note: Book 3+ flights on FlyALS scheduled services to create custom circuits. Discount applies ONLY to Y-class published RACK rates; taxes excluded from discount, applied per sector.

termsAndConditions.fareClass: Terms apply to Y-class fares specifically; other fare classes have different, more restrictive conditions.
termsAndConditions.childFare: 75% of the adult fare before tax, applicable to children aged 2-11 years, applicable only on bush flights (NOT the set-departure Nanyuki-Namunyak-Mara service, which has no child fare at all).

amendment.upTo24hrsBeforeDeparture: $30/person plus fare difference if original class unavailable
amendment.within24to6hrs: 50% of ticket fare plus fare difference if original class unavailable

baggage.safariRoutes: 15kg per person inclusive of hand baggage/cameras, soft bags only

termsAndConditions.firearms: Must be declared at check-in at least 4 hours prior to departure, or directly to the pilot at bush airstrips.

sunworldMaraBushCampSpecialPackage2026.confidenceNote: This is a Sunworld-negotiated, Mara-Bush-Camp-specific promotional fare - significantly cheaper than ALS's general Wilson-Mara rack/contract fares above (e.g. $144-154 net one-way here vs $187 net one-way in the general contract). Do NOT apply this fare to a non-Mara-Bush-Camp booking - it is named/restricted to that specific Sunworld product.

sunworldMaraBushCampSpecialPackage2026.amendmentPolicy: Same $30/50%-penalty/No-Show structure as the main 2026 contract, but change window is 24hrs/6hrs (same as main contract, differs from the promo ratesheet's 24hrs/12hrs window below).

flyAlsPromoRatesheet2026.confidenceNote: General promotional rate, NOT Sunworld/Mara-Bush-Camp-specific like the package above - a third, separate ALS pricing tier alongside the main contract and the Sunworld special package. Requires cash payment within 48hrs of booking. Agent commission 7.5% is applied on the 'Total Payable to FlyALS' figure (i.e. net of commission), a different commission mechanic than the main contract's flat net+tax structure.
